name: zmodel_material_find_by_tex_dir_entry
description: zModel_Material::FindByTexDirEntry walks the active material-slot list and returns the material whose current texture directory entry matches the requested entry.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL exposes the zModel_MaterialSlot stride and returns the slot address because the embedded material is at offset zero. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481420 validates null input returns null, active-list traversal from g_zModel_MatlActiveHeadIndex through each slot's nextPoolIndex, comparison against material.currentTextureDirectoryEntry, and returning the matching embedded material pointer.
The native smoke verifies null input, active-head match, chained nextPoolIndex match, and missing texture-directory-entry null return.
